selection.algorithm: Within every frozen lab/outcome cell, exclude Stage 1.4 episodes, require one metadata JSON agreeing with the path lab/outcome and declaring at least minimum_trajectory_frames, one HDF5 trajectory and exactly three non-stereo MP4 cameras, then SHA-256 rank eligible episodes by dataset_id:stage1.5:lab:outcome:source_episode_prefix and select the first quota_per_lab_outcome.
